programmes.d: Practical, not too big yet spacious and versatile – everyone wants compact cars. That’s why manufacturers offer plenty of choice. Kia has a whole lineup of new models ready to go. We take a look at the new Sportage facelift and other vehicles from the Korean brand’s numeric lineup.

Founded in 1910, the iconic Italian car manufacturer Alfa Romeo experienced a very eventful history. Their 6C 2500 SS model is right in the middle of the company's more than 100-year history. It combined new technology with an early post-war appearance.

All-Wheel drive is not just for off-road adventures. The new Mercedes E-Class T-Model sends its power to all four wheels to ensure abnormal acceleration and the best dynamic handling in bends. Paired with the output of 333 hp, the AMG version becomes a powerful estate wagon.

Small city cars reflect the change of times in regards to new technology and eco-awareness. In 2023, Mitsubishi presented the ASX as a hybrid. And: 40 years of Opel Corsa. We show its transformation from city car to urban e-vehicle.

In Ron's Garage antique scrap piles from the desert get turned into rolling pieces of art in accordance with customer specifications. If you want to cross the desert, Mercedes has the perfect vehicle.

For decades, upper mid-range sedans have stood for the ideal combination of luxury, technology, and performance, especially for families and long distance travels. We put the hybrid Mercedes E 300 e and the fully electric VW ID.7 to the test.

Once a year the noblest and rarest classic cars are gathered at one location: the Concorso d' Eleganza Villa d'Este at Lake Como about 50 kilometers north of Arese. Proud owners present their vintage vehicles from long forgotten decades.

programmes.d: Mercedes in-house tuner AMG has taken the electric E-Class EQE under its wing and unleashes the EQE 53 with 687 hp peak power. An impressive 1000 newtonmeters of maximum torque catapults the electric AMG to 100 km/h in just 3.3 seconds.
